title: This Seal Saws Through Antarctic Ice With Its Teeth to Breathe

scenes.text: This seal saws through Antarctic ice with its own teeth.
It's a Weddell seal, and it lives under the frozen sea.
It needs air, so it scrapes breathing holes in the ice with its front teeth.
It can dive more than 2,000 feet deep.
And it can stay under for 45 minutes or more.
But those teeth wear down, and a worn-out set is thought to be a common cause of death.

description:
Weddell seals scrape open breathing holes in Antarctic sea ice with their teeth. They can dive more than 2,000 feet and stay under for 45 minutes or more.
Would you trust your teeth with your life?
